name: 地理情報と単位を分類した言語・地域設定
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0105 地理情報と単位を分類した言語・地域設定.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: secondary-component-preview. Image 3: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Render one Japanese language, location, and measurement settings list as a flat white component, about 360 logical pixels wide by 320 pixels high. Keep it compact but comfortable: five clear 48px rows with readable text and modest group-label gaps. Include only the selected content crop; do not add the Language & Region toolbar, Cancel or Save, phone frame, status/navigation bars, footer, watermark, or decorative canvas. Preserve this exact order and wording, with no added text: タイムゾーン; ニューヨーク［−5:00］; 言語; 英語（米国）; 地域; 国; 米国; 州; 単位; 長さの単位; ヤード・ポンド法. Use Meiryo Regular 14px/24px for row labels, and Meiryo Regular 12px/16px with zero tracking for values and section labels. Primary labels use #1D1D1D; supporting values and section labels use #6E6E6E. First show the Time Zone row with its right-aligned value and a fine gray chevron, then Language with its value and chevron. Insert the muted 12px 地域 label with only a small natural gap, followed by Country with value 米国 and chevron, then State with no value and a chevron. Insert the same restrained 単位 label, then the 長さの単位 row with value ヤード・ポンド法 and chevron. Use 16px horizontal insets, vertically center text in each 48px row, align values to the right before a small 8px gap and a thin gray chevron, and add subtle 1px separators at the same row boundaries as the source. Preserve the source's line length and grouping. Keep enough surrounding room to scan the values without enlarging gaps or margins. Do not add icons, cards, shadows, gradients, or selection states.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; Do not invent an outer card around a flat component. Only existing card surfaces use rounded corners, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows; flat headings, lists and settings stay flat white. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: Keep this neutral settings list on pure white; use slate gray for supporting values and chevrons and a subtle neutral divider. No green action treatment is needed.
LATEST DIRECT OWNER DENSITY CORRECTION, 2026-10-18: previous candidates were too big and too spacious. This overrides earlier source-spacing and presentation-enlargement instructions. Use compact ordinary UI proportions, content-driven control widths, restrained small radii, tight but readable padding, and little outer presentation whitespace. Preserve exact established Japanese font roles; do not shrink text to manufacture density. Preserve original icon geometry, strokes, states and artwork. Avoid stretching a small standalone utility control across an entire screen. Use the owner-corrected180x28 three-segment control as a density reference only, not a size to force onto unrelated components. Output image pixels are inspection resolution, never intended application CSS size.
reviewNotes: Candidate-only; reviewed at 360x324: all 11 Japanese strings, five setting rows, two muted section labels, source dividers and right chevrons checked. No native or application acceptance claimed.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
